Title: Brass Study I
Subheading: Patterns drawn by corrosion on brass.
Cover Image:alt: Brass Study I, brass plate with chemical patina
Secondary Image:alt: Brass Study I, brass plate with chemical patina
Blog Part 1: Art has always been part of my life, a source of inspiration and a way of expression. The brass works are made by corrosion: brass plates treated with chemical solutions oxidise into patinas whose colours and textures draw their own patterns. The studies began as material swatches for the material suite of the ARC 604 studio and grew into a series in which the reaction itself becomes the image.
Blog Part 2: Brass plate treated with chemical solutions; the patina draws its own pattern.
